Wintersky: [1.4.0](https://github.com/JannisX11/wintersky/releases/tag/v1.4.0)

In this update:

## Changes
* View Reference player (#89)
* Updated the menu bar with more intuitive controls and new icons
* Support for Molang input in color gradient stops (#261)
* Add support for reading versioned Molang versions (#20)
* JSON array vectors with long string values now export as multiline
* Added warning for negative particle size (#119)
* Add collapsible events (#124)
* Added curve duplicate button, changed curve delete button to icon
* Add "Switch to Snowstorm" button to VS Code text editor menu (#129, thanks @ink0rr)

## Features
* Fixed rendering of blend/additive particles behind each other
* Fixed particles freezing for one frame when another particle expires (#21)
* Fixed order of evaluation for particle update expressions to match game
* The emitter activation expression now defaults to 1 to match bedrock (#22)
* Fixed particles playing twice when file was drag+dropped in
* Fixed number input clamping not working when using keyboard (such as collision radius clamping to 0 - 0.5)

detail.readme:
# Snowstorm

Custom editor for Minecraft Bedrock Edition particle files. Available as a web app and VSCode Extension:
* **Web App:** [snowstorm.app](https://snowstorm.app/)
* **VSCode Extension:** [Snowstorm - Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=JannisX11.snowstorm)


## Interface

![Snowstorm interface screenshot](https://snowstorm.app/content/interface.png)


## Development

1. Install node and run `npm install` to install all dependencies

2. Run `npm run watch` to run the bundler and update whenever you change anything

3. Open the app

	#### Web app:

	Use your preferred local server to host the app (npx serve, xampp, etc.), and open it in your browser

	#### VS Code Extension:

	Press F5 to run the Extension Development Host in a new VS Code instance
